runs.action: CRITICAL: fixed broken Cloudflare Pages deploy pipeline
runs.notes: Full SEO audit discovered the live site (amautdc.com) had been frozen at a ~June 18 2026 snapshot since Phase 2 began — every deploy since commit 2737862 (Aug 1) was silently failing. Root cause: Cloudflare Pages Build command was set to `npm run build` (leftover 'Analog' framework preset default) but package.json (added for the sharp image-optimization script) has no build script, so every build errored with `npm error Missing script: "build"` and the site kept serving the last successful pre-Phase-2 deploy. Effect: all 11 new location pages, all 6 blog posts, GA4 tracking, the Spline version pin, and the title-length fixes existed only in GitHub for 23 days and were invisible to Google and to visitors — extensionless URLs like /interlock-kanata and /blog-fence-cost-ottawa returned HTTP 200 but silently served homepage content (soft-404), and the live sitemap.xml only listed the old ~20-URL set. Fixed via Cloudflare dashboard (Pages > amautdc > Settings > Build configuration): cleared Build command and Build output directory to empty (static site, no build step, output = repo root). Retried the de9bddd deployment — succeeded in ~15s. Verified live: /interlock-kanata and /blog-fence-cost-ottawa now serve correct unique content, gtag.js (G-RB3FQ7F1N6) is now firing, and /sitemap.xml now lists all 41 URLs matching crawl-check.mjs's count. This is almost certainly the primary reason rankings hadn't moved despite two months of on-paper SEO work — verdict pending 2-4 weeks of GSC data once ingestion exists, but treat any pre-2026-08-25 ranking/impression data as measuring a stale, incomplete version of the site.

First crawl-check run found 27 pages with >60-char titles (0 other issues: canonicals, internal links, JSON-LD, GA4 all clean). Fixed all 27 via scripts/fix-long-titles.mjs. No GSC data available yet to measure CTR impact of the title changes.
